pairsWith.noteUz: Ko'chirma gap (said/told, zamon o'zgarishi, ko'chirma savollar) coursebook 100-bet qoida va 10-11-mashqlar, 101-bet 13-15-mashqlarga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 14-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (59-bet, PDF 57). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Live and Let Live' va to'q sariq '14'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Grammar':
5) 'Fill in said or told.' 1 "Welcome to our safari park," the guide ...... to the visitors. 2 The wildlife expert ...... us that many species are facing extinction. 3 Ben ...... that he would meet us at the entrance. 4 My parents ...... me that I could have a dog if I looked after it myself. 5 "I'm afraid your cat isn't very well," the vet ...... .
6) 'Read what these people said yesterday, and write each sentence in reported speech.' 5 SURAT (pufaklar): 1 ot yonidagi ayol: 'I love horses.' ...She said that she loved horses.... 2 qushlarni boqayotgan bola: 'I'm feeding the birds.' 3 qayiqdagi ikki erkak va baliq: 'We've just caught a big fish.' 4 Ozodlik haykali oldidagi erkak: 'I was in New York recently.' 5 ota va qiz: 'I'll read you a story.'

O'NG USTUN:
7) 'Jamie recently visited a zoo, and he was asked some questions as part of a survey. Read what he said, then complete the questions in the survey.' JAMIE: 'They asked me if I had visited the zoo before, and if I had enjoyed my visit. They wanted to know what I had liked best about the zoo, and if there had been anything I didn't like. They also asked if I would visit the zoo again, and if I would recommend it to my friends.' 'Compton Zoo - Visitors' Survey': 1 Have ...you visited the zoo before...? 2 Did ......? 3 What ......? 4 Was there ......? 5 Will ......? 6 Will ......?
8) 'Rewrite the questions in reported speech, as in the example.' 1 (ofitsiant qiz) 'Are you ready to order yet?' The waitress asked them ...if they were ready to order yet.... 2 'Can I go and play in the park?' The boy asked his mother ...... 3 'Do you think it will rain?' My friend asked me ...... 4 'Have you ever been to Britain?' The teacher asked her students ...... 5 'How much does the white skirt cost?' Jill asked the shop assistant ......

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '59'.

exercises.explanationUz:
SAY / TELL (coursebook 100-bet
  qoidasi).

  SAID (+ to sb) - kimga
    aytilgani SHART EMAS:
    'the guide SAID to the visitors'
    'Ben SAID that'
    'the vet SAID'
  TOLD + KIShI (majburiy!):
    'the expert TOLD us'
    'my parents TOLD me'

  ⚠ 'told' dan keyin HAR DOIM kishi
  (me, us, him ...). 'said' dan
  keyin 'to' + kishi yoki hech
  narsa.


⚠ 'A WILDLIFE EXPERT':

  = yovvoyi tabiat mutaxassisi.


⚠ 'FACING EXTINCTION':

  = yo'qolib ketish arafasida.


⚠ 'THE ENTRANCE':

  = kirish joyi.

items.textEn: "Welcome to our safari park," the guide ___ to the visitors.
The wildlife expert ___ us that many species are facing extinction.
Ben ___ that he would meet us at the entrance.
My parents ___ me that I could have a dog if I looked after it myself.
"I'm afraid your cat isn't very well," the vet ___ .

exercises.instructionEn: Read what these people said yesterday, and write each sentence in reported speech. 1 'I love horses.' 2 'I'm feeding the birds.' 3 'We've just caught a big fish.' 4 'I was in New York recently.' 5 'I'll read you a story.' Example: She said that she loved horses.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar kecha nima deganini o'qing va har bir gapni ko'chirma gapda yozing. 1 'I love horses.' 2 'I'm feeding the birds.' 3 'We've just caught a big fish.' 4 'I was in New York recently.' 5 'I'll read you a story.' Namuna: U otlarni yaxshi ko'rishini aytdi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP - ZAMON BIR QADAM
  ORQAGA (coursebook 100-bet
  jadvali).

  present simple → PAST SIMPLE
    'I love' → she LOVED
  present continuous → PAST
    CONTINUOUS
    'I'm feeding' → he WAS FEEDING
  present perfect → PAST PERFECT
    'We've caught' → they HAD
    CAUGHT
  past simple → PAST PERFECT
    'I was' → he HAD BEEN
  will → WOULD
    'I'll read' → he WOULD READ

  ⚠ OLMOShLAR ham o'zgaradi:
  I → she/he, we → they, you → her.
exercises.exampleEn: She said that she loved horses.
modelAnswers: He said that he was feeding the birds.
They said that they had just caught a big fish.
He said that he had been in New York recently.
He said that he would read her a story.
modelAnswersUz: Ular endigina katta baliq tutganlarini aytishdi.
U unga ertak o'qib berishini aytdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Jamie recently visited a zoo, and he was asked some questions as part of a survey. Read what he said, then complete the questions in the survey. Jamie: 'They asked me if I had visited the zoo before, and if I had enjoyed my visit. They wanted to know what I had liked best about the zoo, and if there had been anything I didn't like. They also asked if I would visit the zoo again, and if I would recommend it to my friends.' Compton Zoo - Visitors' Survey.
exercises.instructionUz: Jeymi yaqinda hayvonot bog'iga bordi va so'rovnoma doirasida unga savollar berildi. U aytganlarini o'qing, so'ng so'rovnomadagi savollarni to'ldiring. Jeymi: 'Ular mendan ilgari hayvonot bog'iga borganmanmi va tashrifim yoqdimi deb so'rashdi. Hayvonot bog'ida eng ko'p nima yoqqanini va yoqmagan narsa bo'lganmi bilishmoqchi edi. Yana hayvonot bog'iga qayta boramanmi va do'stlarimga tavsiya qilamanmi deb so'rashdi.' Compton hayvonot bog'i - Tashrif buyuruvchilar so'rovnomasi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAPDAN TO'G'RI GAPGA
  (teskari yo'nalish!).

  Zamon bir qadam OLDINGA:
  had visited → HAVE you visited
  had enjoyed → DID you enjoy
  had liked → WHAT did you like
  had been → WAS there
  would visit → WILL you visit
  would recommend → WILL you
    recommend

  ⚠ 'if' → so'roq tartibi; 'what' →
  wh-savol.
  ⚠ 'me/my' → 'you/your'.


⚠ 'AS PART OF A SURVEY':

  = so'rovnoma doirasida.

items.hintUz: 'if there had been anything I didn't like'

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the questions in reported speech, as in the example. 1 'Are you ready to order yet?' The waitress asked them ... 2 'Can I go and play in the park?' The boy asked his mother ... 3 'Do you think it will rain?' My friend asked me ... 4 'Have you ever been to Britain?' The teacher asked her students ... 5 'How much does the white skirt cost?' Jill asked the shop assistant ... Example: The waitress asked them if they were ready to order yet.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni ko'chirma gapda qayta yozing, namunadagidek. 1 'Are you ready to order yet?' The waitress asked them ... 2 'Can I go and play in the park?' The boy asked his mother ... 3 'Do you think it will rain?' My friend asked me ... 4 'Have you ever been to Britain?' The teacher asked her students ... 5 'How much does the white skirt cost?' Jill asked the shop assistant ... Namuna: Ofitsiant qiz ulardan buyurtma berishga tayyormi deb so'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR (coursebook
  101-bet 13-mashq).

  YES/NO SAVOL → asked + kishi + IF
    + GAP TARTIBI (ega + fe'l):
    'Are you ready?' → asked them
    IF THEY WERE ready
  WH-SAVOL → asked + kishi + WH +
    GAP TARTIBI:
    'How much does it cost?' →
    asked HOW MUCH it COST

  ⚠ SO'ROQ TARTIBI YO'Q, 'do/does'
  YO'Q, savol belgisi YO'Q.

  ZAMON:
  are → were; can → could; do you
  think → thought; will → would;
  have been → had been; does cost
  → cost (past).


⚠ 'A SHOP ASSISTANT':

  = sotuvchi.
exercises.exampleEn: The waitress asked them if they were ready to order yet.
exercises.exampleUz: Ofitsiant qiz ulardan buyurtma berishga tayyormi deb so'radi.
modelAnswers: The boy asked his mother if he could go and play in the park.
My friend asked me if I thought it would rain.
The teacher asked her students if they had ever been to Britain.
Jill asked the shop assistant how much the white skirt cost.
modelAnswersUz: Bola onasidan bog'ga o'ynagani borsa bo'ladimi deb so'radi.
Do'stim mendan yomg'ir yog'adi deb o'ylaymanmi deb so'radi.
O'qituvchi o'quvchilaridan Britaniyada bo'lganmisiz deb so'radi.
Jill sotuvchidan oq yubka qancha turishini so'radi.

patterns.formula: X said (that) + GAP (zamon bir qadam orqaga).
patterns.exampleEn: 'I love horses.' → She said that she loved horses.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Otlarni yaxshi ko'raman.' → U otlarni yaxshi ko'rishini aytdi.

patterns.exampleEn: My parents told me that I could have a dog.
patterns.exampleUz: Ota-onam menga it olishim mumkinligini aytishdi.

patterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + if + GAP TARTIBI.
patterns.exampleEn: The waitress asked them if they were ready to order.
patterns.exampleUz: Ofitsiant qiz ulardan buyurtma berishga tayyormi deb so'radi.

patterns.formula: X asked + KIShI + WH-so'z + GAP TARTIBI.
patterns.exampleEn: Jill asked the shop assistant how much the skirt cost.
patterns.exampleUz: Jill sotuvchidan yubka qancha turishini so'radi.
